beforeImage.name: Mosaic Forest Management
beforeImage.description: Mosaic Forest Management is a timberlands management company overseeing large private forestlands and associated public tenures on Vancouver Island and coastal British Columbia. The platform serves timber, lumber, and broader forest-products markets through harvesting, stewardship, and land-management activities. Its operating model is asset-heavy because it manages extensive timberlands where value is tied to land quality, biological growth, harvest planning, and log sales. Company materials describe Mosaic as the manager for the TimberWest and Island Timberlands ownership interests and note a supply chain supporting roughly 2,000 employees and contractors. Operations are concentrated in British Columbia, particularly on Vancouver Island and the province's coast. Mosaic launched in 2018 as the management platform for TimberWest and Island Timberlands; BCI's 2024 I&RR financial statements disclose a 56.1% ownership interest in Mosaic LP, while public materials also identify PSP Investments as an underlying ownership partner.

milestones.event: Mosaic began managing extensive private forest lands and public tenures in coastal British Columbia.
BCI, PSP Investments, and AIMCo-affiliated Island Timberlands investors launched Mosaic Forest Management as the management platform for TimberWest and Island Timberlands.

afterImage.name: Mosaic Forest Management
afterImage.description: Mosaic Forest Management is a Canadian timberlands and land-management platform overseeing the TimberWest and Island Timberlands interests across Vancouver Island and coastal British Columbia. The business manages sustainable forestry, timber production and related land uses, including renewable-energy, watershed, recreation, real-estate and carbon initiatives. Mosaic launched on November 1, 2018. BCI remains the in-scope infrastructure owner through its Infrastructure & Renewable Resources program and reported a 56.1% interest in Mosaic LP at year-end 2025. PSP Investments remains the other legal owner through its Natural Resources mandate; its exact published percentage is not publicly disclosed, and it is not treated as a PSP Infrastructure holding. AIMCo participated at launch but was no longer named in Mosaic's 2024 statutory ownership report, so it is preserved as a former owner with an undisclosed exit date.
